title: Vacuum-load adhering device for lifting e.g. natural stone slabs, has suction space staying in connection with another suction space, and suction plate possessing larger dimension than another suction plate

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum load device with a basic body and suction plates, but does not explicitly mention a housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body.

features.item: An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
features.note: (non-English passage at claim 1) The reference discloses a vacuum generating device (4) in a basic body (2) that creates negative pressure, which implies an electrically operated device for such an application.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
features.note: The reference does not describe the routing of exhaust air, especially not through a hollow grip portion.

features.item: A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
features.note: The reference does not mention any sound-damping devices or materials.

features.item: A suction plate with carrier plate and seal extending around the carrier plate
features.note: (non-English passage at claim 1) The reference describes a first suction plate (5) with a first sealing means (6) arranged on a first retaining plate (8), which functions as a carrier plate.

features.item: A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping in grip
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum load device with a vacuum generator, but lacks details about a grip unit, hollow grip portion, exhaust air routing through the grip, or sound-damping.

features.item: Grip unit and suction plate combined in a vacuum handling apparatus
features.note: (non-English passage at claim 1) The reference describes a vacuum load device for lifting objects with suction plates, which implies a vacuum handling apparatus. However, it does not explicitly mention a 'grip unit' as a distinct component combined with the suction plate.

features.item: Grip portion at least partially lined with sound-damping material
features.note: The reference does not mention any grip portion or sound-damping material.

features.item: Vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion
features.note: (non-English passage at claim 1) The reference states the vacuum generating device (4) is in a basic body (2), which can be interpreted as a first housing portion.

features.item: Sound-reducing device in the first housing portion or first housing portion lined with sound-reducing material
features.note: The reference does not mention any sound-reducing devices or materials within the housing.

features.item: Grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions with air outlet on second housing portion
features.note: The reference does not describe an elongated grip portion between housing parts or an air outlet on a second housing portion.

features.item: Air collection screw upstream of grip portion in first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
features.note: The reference does not describe any air collection screw or exhaust air collection mechanism.

features.item: Bent or curved air baffles downstream of grip portion directing exhaust air to air outlet
features.note: The reference does not describe any air baffles or specific exhaust air routing.

features.item: Battery coupling point on second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from battery coupling point
features.note: The reference does not mention a battery coupling point or air baffles for exhaust air.

features.item: Grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device
features.note: (non-English passage at claim 2) The reference describes a second suction plate (10) attachable to the vacuum load device (1) via a fastening device (15), which can be a quick-release or bayonet coupling, indicating a releasable connection.

features.item: Grip unit with suction opening fluidically connected to suction chamber delimited by suction plate
features.note: (non-English passage at claim 1) The reference discloses a suction chamber (7) connected to a vacuum device (4). However, it does not explicitly mention a 'grip unit' with a suction opening fluidically connected to this chamber.

claims.note: The reference describes a vacuum-load adhering device with suction plates, but does not explicitly mention a 'grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device'.

The reference does not describe the grip portion as a hollow body.
The reference does not describe exhaust air being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet, nor does it mention a sound-damping device.

The reference does not mention a sound-reducing device in a housing portion or a housing portion lined with sound-reducing material.

The reference describes a vacuum-load device with suction plates and sealing means, but it does not mention a grip unit with an elongated grip portion between first and second housing portions, nor an air outlet arranged on a second housing portion.
The reference describes a vacuum-load device but does not disclose an air collection device, an air collection screw, or the collection of exhaust air before passing it to a grip portion.
The reference does not describe a grip portion, housing portions, or air baffles for guiding exhaust air to an air outlet.
The reference does not mention a battery coupling point for an electrical energy storage device or rechargeable battery, nor air baffles for directing exhaust air away from such a point.

overall.why: The reference describes a vacuum load device with multiple suction plates and a vacuum generating unit, which aligns with the core concept of the subject invention.
